name: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon (21.1 km, plus 10 km and 5 km options) set for June 13, 2027 at Botumvatey Pagoda Park in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
ai_summary: The Phnom Penh International Half Marathon is scheduled for June 13, 2027, at Botumvatey Pagoda Park in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. The event offers three distance options: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race, catering to a range of runner abilities. Registration has not yet been announced, so prospective participants should watch for updates. The organizer is not explicitly named but is noted to be the same organizer behind the E19 and E68 events.
